title: No early completion while scanning a successor field
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $src,dst$ be distinct work-tape indices, let $copy$ be a Boolean, and let $d$ be a configuration of the successor-field machine. Let $s$ be either absent or a state index less than $n$. Suppose $d$ is in the tag state and the source tape, starting at its head position, contains the complete optional-state encoding of $s$. At every time $t$ strictly less than the length of that encoding, the machine's state is not any done state.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a configuration of the successor-field machine
$s$ is absent or a state index less than $n$
the source tape contains the optional-state encoding of $s$ from its head position
